newsitem.title: USA: Catellus says shrs converted to common stock.
newsitem.headline: Catellus says shrs converted to common stock.

text.p: Catellus Development Corp said Thursday the 1.52 million shares of its series B preferred stock called for redemption on May 1 were converted into 7,733,000 shares of common stock.

Catellus said the move completes the fifth and final call in its redemption program to eliminate its outstanding preferred stock. The elimination of its preferred shares will save the company about $24 million in annual dividends.
As of Thursday, Catellus has 106.3 million common shares outstanding.
Catellus Development develops and manages real estate.
